description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Find candidate datasets for a region and weather variable. Filter by provider, region, forecast_time, shared_parameter and is_ensemble; sort_by=resolution ranks nominal resolution in km. With shared_parameter, each result includes a validated request fragment and exact/approximate match. Use it directly in one gribstream_query_timeseries call. Coverage envelopes and forecast horizons are catalog hints, not live availability guarantees. No weather values are fetched.

code.description: Dataset code or list of dataset codes, for example gfs or ["gfs", "ifsoper"].

family.description: Dataset family filter, for example gfs, ifs, nbm, hrrr, rap, rtma, urma.

forecast_time.description: Optional RFC3339 valid time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-16T12:00:00-03:00. Response normalizes to UTC. Filters nominal horizon, not live run availability. Resolve place and local timezone first; never assume local noon is UTC noon.

is_ensemble.description: Filter to ensemble datasets when true, or deterministic datasets when false.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return; omit to inspect alternatives including unknown coverage.

provider.description: Case-insensitive provider substring, e.g. Met Office, ECMWF, NOAA, DWD.

shared_parameter.description: Weather concept code, e.g. temperature_2m. Return only validated equivalents, including request fragments and approximation labels.

sort_by.description: Sort candidates by nominal source resolution, finest first; unknown coverage/resolution sorts last. Read coverage_kind before claiming a winner.

tag.description: Tag or list of tags. Multiple tags use AND semantics in the API.

name: gribstream_list_datasets
title: List GribStream datasets
